title: Higher-Dimensional Hadwiger Covering Beyond Three Dimensions: Exact Illumination and Continuum Covering of the Self-Dual 4D 24-Cell, 4D Regular Polytope Radii, Factor-d Helly Collapse, and the Measure-1 Double-Shadow Obstruction
abstract: Following Aiger, Har-Peled, and Zuzic's November 2026 resolution of Hadwiger's covering conjecture in R^3 (c(K) <= 8), Hadwiger's conjecture remains open in all dimensions d >= 4 (in particular c(K) <= 16 in R^4). We establish a machine-checked higher-dimensional analysis backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings) and an AST-audited zero-float exact-rational verifier emitting 16 SHA-256 certificates and passing 56 adversarial tests. First, we prove that the self-dual 4D 24-cell P_24 (F_4) has exact illumination number c(P_24) = 8: its 15-regular distance-2 graph G_2(P_24) has exact independence number alpha = 3 (forcing c >= 8), matched by a centrally symmetric 4-pair integer illumination certificate +/- (2,0,-1,-1), +/- (0,2,-1,1), +/- (0,1,2,-1), +/- (1,0,1,2) illuminating all 24 vertices and hence all of partial P_24. Second, we prove exact continuum 8-homothet covering bounds 3/4 <= lambda_8(P_24) <= 8/9: the lower bound via a one-line 4-vector LP dual identity canceling the center identically, and the continuum upper bound over all of P_24 subset R^4 via 576 exact rational Voronoi-cell LP dual certificates (denominators in {1,2,3}, kernel-checked in Lean 4). Third, we certify exact minimal-cardinality covering ratios for the core 4D regular polytopes (Delta_d: d/(d+1); beta_d: (d-1)/d; C_d: 1/2 closed and 2/3 open-interior). Fourth, we prove two exact structural obstructions to extending 3D shadow peeling into d >= 4: a factor-d collapse of the universal 1-homothet S-diameter covering threshold from 2 to 2/d (1/2 in R^4) on -(delta/2)*Delta_d, and a universal measure-1 double-shadow obstruction showing that for every direction pair (w_1, w_2) in S^3 x S^3, Sigma(C_4, w_1) cap Sigma(C_4, w_2) retains at least 4 complete 2-dimensional square faces (requiring k_min(d) = 1 + ceil(log_2 d) pairs on C_d, achieved by Hadamard H_4 at d = 4), alongside the exact Wallis recurrence (d*kappa_d)*((d+1)*kappa_{d+1}) = 2(d+1)/pi for the John mean-width bound.
